notes.title: New Holiday Themed Map!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45280960/264e2d494a730e142cda09810c6e4bcdf7721219.png

A new map is here to spread holiday cheer! Cozy Cabin is a small two lane map with a warm palette and festive decor. Fight over the central present and stuffed elephants to get a leg up on you opponent. Happy holidays!

Changes:


 New Map “Cozy Cabin”
 New Song
 Minor bugfixes


…………………………………………………………………………

'Twas the night before update, in a cabin so warm,
With presents set out and trees all adorned.
The babies were resting, tucked snug in their beds,
While visions of crawlers danced 'round in their heads.

But just as the silence seemed calm and so sweet,
A loud noise erupted, disturbing their sleep!
Twin babies awoke with a cry and a shout,
And out of their cribs, they both climbed about.

One grabbed a rattle, the other a ball,
They glared at each other, preparing to brawl.
No giggles just grumbles, they started to fight,
While collecting toy parts in the warm fire light.

Gathering upgrades, getting stronger indeed,
And recruiting stuffed elephants, for the teams that they lead.
The room filled with chaos, a holiday mess,
These twins were determined to settle who’s best!

And soon, with a boom a pillow fort fell,
Now put in last stand, can this still go well?
”Lock in”, they thought, “the game is still mine”,
”With all of my power, I’m sure I’ll be fine”.

So lock in they did, both babies in fact,
Treating these final moments with grace and tact.
And when the dust settled, it seemed a winner was found,
But …. ”how about a best of three, I’m winning next round!”
